text:
Predicates:
Mammal(x) ::: x is a mammal.
HaveTeeth(x) ::: x has teeth.
Platypus ::: a specific individual, a platypus.
Human ::: a specific individual, a human.
Premises:
Some mammals have teeth ::: ∃x (Mammal(x) ∧ HaveTeeth(x))
Platypus have no teeth ::: HaveTeeth(Platypus) is false
Platypus are mammals ::: Mammal(Platypus)
Humans have teeth ::: HaveTeeth(Human)
Conclusion:
Humans are mammals ::: Mammal(Human)
